text: ぼくの　とりポケが　きみたちの　ことを　おぼえている！

structure.jp: ぼくの　とりポケが
きみたちの　ことを

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means 'things about that person' and is often used with verbs of knowing or feeling; it is not put into English. きみたちの　ことを　おぼえている = 'remember you'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on now; おぼえる 'learn by heart' becomes 'remember'. おぼえている = 'remember'.
